title: Peritoneal antiseptic irrigation to prevent surgical site infection after laparotomy for hepatobiliary or gastrointestinal surgery
summary: The PAISI trial evaluates the effect of rinsing the abdominal cavity at the end of open surgical procedures on the gastrointestinal tract with an antiseptic solution (NaHOCl/HOCl) compared to standard rinsing with Ringers Solution, on the rate of postoperative surgical site infections.
conditions: Infection following a procedure, not elsewhere classified
Disruption of operation wound, not elsewhere classified

interventions.name: Prophylactic peritoneal irrigation with 1000ml NaOCl/HOCl (50/50ppm) solution before closure of the abdominal fascia, subcutaneous wound irrigation with another 500ml of the solution after closure of the fascia
The same intervention using 1500ml Ringer Solution
